description: The Historical Planimetric Map Series was initiated in 1949 using aerial photographs from 1949 to 1952. Six reviewed NTS-block packages form this series. They depict provincial highways, roads, pipelines, transmission lines, municipalities, hydrography and the Alberta Township System. The source says the maps are not GIS-ready, provincial coverage is incomplete and further coverage is uncertain. PDF files are offered, with TIFF on request. Georeferenced PNG availability varies: the block72 description says most maps, while the other reviewed blocks say some maps, sometimes roughly aligned with few control points. Some sheets were updated after initial publication. These statements do not establish current assets, uniform survey dates or numerical accuracy. Geographic coverage is within Alberta. Related map components retain their native catalogue identities. The native packages list Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, but isopen is false. Actual file access and any cost are unverified. Distribution metadata mainly points to HTML/XML descriptive pages; these are not machine-readable infrastructure geometries. No map, PDF, image, archive or dataset body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are not stated.
